about: Habakkuk asked God hard questions, and learned to trust Him no matter what.

pages.title: Even If
pages.scene: Habakkuk on a watchtower waiting for God's answer
pages.text: Habakkuk asked, "God, why do bad things happen?" God said, "Wait. I have a plan." Habakkuk said, "Even if the fig tree has no figs, and the fields have no food, I will still be happy in the Lord. He is my strength!"
pages.lesson: Trust God and be glad in Him, no matter what.
